title: Casino War
betGuide: Place an ante; one card is dealt to you and one to the dealer.
tieGuide: Tie! Surrender (lose half ante) or go to War (match ante and re-draw).
warTieRule: If War results in another tie, the player wins.
betUnavailable: At least 10 chips are required to bet.
betTooSmall: The bet must be at least 10 chips.
betNotMultiple: The bet must be a multiple of 10 chips.
betExceedsChips: The bet exceeds your chip balance.

tutorial.betControls: Enter your ante and place the bet
tutorial.actionButtons: On a tie, choose surrender or go to war

hint.warEv: Going to war has a smaller house edge than surrender — recommended
